system.description:
Once per long rest, choose any targets
within Very Close range to perceive you
as a nightmarish threat, impossible
assassin, corrupted sensor ghost, or
fear-triggered hallucination.
The targets must succeed ona
Reaction Roll (16) or become
temporarily Horrified. While Horrified,
they’re Vulnerable.
Steal a number of Fear from the GM
equal to the number of targets that are
Horrified, up to the number of Fear in
the GM’s pool.
Roll a number of d6s equal to the
number of stolen Fear and deal the
total damage to each Horrified target.
Discard the stolen Fear.
